## 修改内容

**位置**：Discussion 第一段（段末），即以 “A number of studies have reported disparate OS out…” 开头的那一段，paraId `1FBA2992`。

**修改方式**：以 Word 修订（tracked change）形式，在段末追加了一段比较性文字（change_id 104，作者 “Claude”，需你在 Word 中接受）：

> Similar results were reported by Jingu et al., who, in an updated phase II study of 30 patients with postoperative loco-regional recurrent esophageal cancer treated with radiotherapy (60 Gy/30 fractions) combined with nedaplatin and 5-fluorouracil, demonstrated a median survival period of 21.0 months and a 5-year overall survival rate of 27.0%, together with a 5-year progression-free survival rate of 25.1%, an irradiated-field control rate of 71.5%, and grade ≥3 late toxicity in only one patient.(15) These figures are consistent with the median OS of 18.14 months observed in the ICIs + RT group of the present study.
